# Francis Ngannou

## Early Life
- Born September 5, 1986, in Batié, Cameroon
- Grew up in extreme poverty in a small village without electricity or running water
- His mother was a sex worker; his father was largely absent
- Had minimal formal education

## Rise to MMA
- Moved to France at 10 to pursue education but faced hardship
- Discovered MMA and trained at a gym while homeless in France
- Eventually moved to the US to pursue fighting professionally
- Known for his powerful striking and heavy hands

## UFC Career (2015-2023)
- Debuted in UFC in 2015
- Built a reputation as a knockout artist
- **UFC Heavyweight Champion**: Won the title in 2018, defeating Stipe Miocic
- Lost and regained the title in rematches with Miocic
- Notable fights with Derrick Lewis, Junior dos Santos, and Ciryl Gane
- Left UFC in 2023 after contract disputes and pursuit of other opportunities

## Post-UFC
- Signed with PFL (Professional Fighters League) in 2023
- Competed in their heavyweight division
- Explored boxing and other ventures

## Outside the Octagon
- Strong advocate for fighter pay and union rights
- Documented his story in the film "Reborn Champion"
- Motivational speaker known for his rags-to-riches narrative
- Philanthropic work in his native Cameroon
